definitions.explanation: A material that allows electric current or heat to flow through it easily. Metals like copper and aluminum are typical conductors.

examples.japanese: {銅|どう}は{良|よ}い{導体|どうたい}だ。
{金属|きんぞく}は{電気|でんき}の{導体|どうたい}として{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: Metals are used as electrical conductors.

examples.japanese: {超伝導|ちょうでんどう}{導体|どうたい}は{電気|でんき}{抵抗|ていこう}がゼロになる{特殊|とくしゅ}な{物質|ぶっしつ}だ。
examples.english: A superconductor is a special material whose electrical resistance drops to zero.

notes: A physics and engineering term. The opposite is {絶縁体|ぜつえんたい} (insulator), and materials with intermediate conductivity are called {半導体|はんどうたい} (semiconductor). Not to be confused with the homophone {胴体|どうたい} (torso; fuselage). Common collocations: {良|りょう}{導体|どうたい} (good conductor), {超伝導|ちょうでんどう}{導体|どうたい} (superconductor).
